name: llama.cpp SYCL B580 tuning
summary: Local llama.cpp SYCL rebuild with a flash-attention parallel-blocks knob (GGML_SYCL_FA_PB) and unsupported-type CPU fallback, tuned for Intel Arc B580 12 GB.
notes: Build: oneAPI 2026.0, GGML_SYCL=ON, GGML_SYCL_F16=ON. Measured +7% decode at 44K context on 35B-A3B flash-attention shapes; unsupported quant types warn and fall back to CPU instead of aborting the process. See the repository for the patches and the full measurement detail.
